200.description: A Server-Sent Events stream. Each frame is `event: <name>` and `data: <json>` on their own lines, terminated by a blank line. The event names are `text`, `status`, `tool_streaming`, `tool_call`, `tool_result`, `elicitation`, `warning`, `error`, `done`; their payloads are described by the ChatStream*Data models in src/ai/page_routes.py. A clean stream ends with `done`; a fatal one ends with `error`.
